notes: Original compact player instructions. Factual IDs, dates, dependencies and rewards follow the cited game tables; item locations and actions are cross-checked against player guides. Dates are earliest eligibility, including prerequisite and story gates. Completion means reported to Elizabeth, not item collected.

entries.title: Muscle Drink
steps: Buy a Muscle Drink for ¥1,000 at Aohige Pharmacy in Paulownia Mall and give it to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Old Document 1
steps: Open the document chest on Tartarus floor 22, then report to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Defeat 100 Shadows
steps: Reach 100 total Shadow defeats. Progress is cumulative; report each unlocked milestone to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Open 50 chests
steps: Open 50 treasure chests across your playthrough, then report the milestone.

entries.title: Persona level 13+
steps: Keep any Persona at level 13 or higher in your active stock when speaking to Elizabeth. Leveling an existing Persona works; its base fusion level need not meet the target.

entries.title: Persona with Kouha
steps: Archangel starts with Kouha. Fuse one through the Persona reference, retain the skill and show it to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Juzumaru
steps: Open the chest requiring 3 Twilight Fragments on Tartarus floor 36. Keep the weapon until Elizabeth has seen it.

entries.title: Rarity Fortune
steps: Enter Club Escapade with Courage rank 2 or higher. Buy a Rarity Fortune for ¥3,000.
Visit Tartarus that same evening and hunt a rare golden Shadow, then report to Elizabeth.

entries.title: 12 vending-machine drinks
steps: Buy each distinct drink from the dorm 2F and 3F, Port Island Station and Iwatodai Strip Mall 3F vending machines. Keep all 12 until you report.

entries.title: Umiushi Beef Bowl
steps: Buy the Umiushi Fan Book at the Iwatodai net cafe and use it on the dorm shared computer.
Order the takeaway beef bowl at Umiushi on Iwatodai 3F and bring it to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Big Eater Challenge
steps: Accept the request and enter the challenge at Wilduck Burger. Choose responses 2, 1, 2: look away, keep eating, then picture a sour taste. Budget ¥1,800 and one time slot.

entries.title: Pine Resin
steps: Accept request 12, then speak to Yukari at the dorm in the evening. Take the item to Elizabeth before the deadline.

entries.title: Handheld Game Console
steps: Accept request 13, then speak to Junpei at the dorm in the evening. Take the item to Elizabeth before the deadline.

entries.title: Old Document 2
steps: Open the document chest on Tartarus floor 43, then report to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Defeat 200 Shadows
steps: Reach 200 total Shadow defeats. Progress is cumulative; report each unlocked milestone to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Open 100 chests
steps: Open 100 treasure chests across your playthrough, then report the milestone.

entries.title: Oberon with Mazio
steps: Fuse Oberon from Archangel and Silky. Level Oberon to 17 to learn Mazio, keep the skill, and show him to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Rose Bouquet
steps: Buy a Rose Bouquet for ¥2,000 from Rafflesia at Port Island Station, then deliver it.

entries.title: Three Jack Frost dolls
steps: Win 3 Jack Frost Dolls at the Game Parade crane machine in Paulownia Mall. Keep playing until you have all three; the cost varies with luck.

entries.title: Potent Medicine
steps: Accept the request and visit the school nurse. Visiting on a school day after Tartarus gives access to his medicine conversation; ask about the request and take the item to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Old Document 3
steps: Open the document chest on Tartarus floor 69, then report to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Defeat 300 Shadows
steps: Reach 300 total Shadow defeats. Progress is cumulative; report each unlocked milestone to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Perform 20 fusions
steps: Perform 20 Persona fusions in total, then report the milestone. Register useful Personas before fusing them away.

entries.title: Persona level 23+
steps: Keep any Persona at level 23 or higher in your active stock when speaking to Elizabeth. Leveling an existing Persona works; its base fusion level need not meet the target.

entries.title: Mithras level 26+
steps: Fuse Oberon and Leanan Sidhe into Mithras, then level him to at least 26 before reporting. Arcana bonus experience can help, but no particular Social Link rank is required.

entries.title: Onimaru Kunitsuna
steps: Open the chest requiring 3 Twilight Fragments on Tartarus floor 54. Keep the weapon until Elizabeth has seen it.

entries.title: Triangular Sword
steps: Accept request 27, then speak to Mitsuru at the dorm in the evening. Take the item to Elizabeth before the deadline.

entries.title: Protein
steps: Accept request 28, then speak to Akihiko at the dorm in the evening. Take the item to Elizabeth before the deadline.

entries.title: Fashionable Glasses
steps: Speak to the accessory vendor inside Club Escapade. Bring a Black Quartz to negotiate the ¥10,000 price.
Black Quartz is available from Lustful Snake drops in upper Arqa or the floor 64 rescue reward. Keep the glasses for Elizabeth.

entries.title: Old Document 4
steps: Open the document chest on Tartarus floor 92, then report to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Defeat 450 Shadows
steps: Reach 450 total Shadow defeats. Progress is cumulative; report each unlocked milestone to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Open 150 chests
steps: Open 150 treasure chests across your playthrough, then report the milestone.

entries.title: Perform 35 fusions
steps: Perform 35 Persona fusions in total, then report the milestone. Register useful Personas before fusing them away.

entries.title: Persona with Torrent Shot
steps: Eligor starts with Torrent Shot. Obtain one through fusion and retain the skill when reporting.

entries.title: Mothman with Agilao
steps: Defeat the gatekeeper on Tartarus floor 82 to unlock Mothman.
Fuse Sati with Agilao and Shiisaa into Mothman, inheriting Agilao. Show the result to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Rustic Coin
steps: Defeat a rare golden Shadow in Yabbashah and keep its Rustic Coin. A Rarity Fortune before Tartarus increases rare encounters.

entries.title: First Monad Passage
steps: After the floor 80 Monad tutorial, clear all encounters in the fixed Monad Passage on floor 91. Open its end chests and report.

entries.title: Chilled Taiyaki
steps: Buy the School X Site Note from the URL seller in Club Escapade, then read it on the dorm computer. Buy Lukewarm Taiyaki at the school store.

Put one in the dorm refrigerator when there is space, then collect it the next day. Later refrigerator opportunities include July 29, August 27, September 26 and November 11. Bring one Chilled Taiyaki to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Gekkoukan music CD
steps: With the request accepted, examine the PA Room on school 2F beside your classroom. Collect the CD and report.

entries.title: Max Safety Shoes
steps: Buy the ¥9,800 TV offer on July 12 and wait for delivery. Keep the shoes for Elizabeth.
If you missed the offer, check the Port Island Station seller. The July 12 date is a purchase opportunity, not a confirmed turn-in deadline.

entries.title: Tanaka's autograph
steps: Start the Devil Social Link with Tanaka to receive the relevant autograph/business card, then show it to Elizabeth. See Devil introduction requirements in Social Links.

entries.title: Feed the station cat
steps: Buy 4 Super Cat Foods from Aohige Pharmacy, then feed the cat at Port Island Station Outskirts on four different days. Report once the sequence finishes.

entries.title: Christmas Star
steps: Accept request 43, then speak to Fuuka at the dorm in the evening. Take the item to Elizabeth before the deadline.

entries.title: Yakushima beach souvenir
steps: Accept request 44 before leaving for Yakushima.
During free exploration on July 20, inspect the beach for a seashell or another souvenir. Take it to Elizabeth after returning.

entries.title: Old Document 5
steps: Open the document chest on Tartarus floor 118, then report to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Defeat 600 Shadows
steps: Reach 600 total Shadow defeats. Progress is cumulative; report each unlocked milestone to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Open 200 chests
steps: Open 200 treasure chests across your playthrough, then report the milestone.

entries.title: Perform 50 fusions
steps: Perform 50 Persona fusions in total, then report the milestone. Register useful Personas before fusing them away.

entries.title: Persona level 38+
steps: Keep any Persona at level 38 or higher in your active stock when speaking to Elizabeth. Leveling an existing Persona works; its base fusion level need not meet the target.

entries.title: King and I Theurgy
steps: Register both King Frost and Black Frost. Request 24 unlocks King Frost; Black Frost uses Jack Frost, Jack-o'-Lantern and King Frost in special fusion.
Speak to Elizabeth to unlock King and I, then report the request.

entries.title: Outenta Mitsuyo
steps: Craft at Mayoido Antiques using Nihil Blade ×1, Black Quartz ×5.
Keep the weapon until Elizabeth has seen it.

entries.title: Home-cooked food
steps: Spend an evening cooking with Yukari or Akihiko at the dorm. Save the resulting food and bring it to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Home-grown potato
steps: Buy a Buff Potato Sprout at Rafflesia, plant it on the dorm roof and harvest it after 12 days. Keep a Tarukaja Potato for Elizabeth.

entries.title: Shrine visits
steps: Accept the request and examine the Naganaki Shrine altar on three different days. Collect the ¥500 bill from the sequence and bring it to Elizabeth; 100 time-consuming visits are unnecessary.

entries.title: Proof of a maxed bond
steps: Reach rank 10 with a Social Link and bring the keepsake from the final meeting to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Queen Elizabeth drink
steps: With Charm rank 5 or higher, ask at Que Sera Sera in Port Island Station Outskirts for the drink. Bring it to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Aojiru
steps: Ask Aohige Pharmacy about the drink. Exchange 2 Topaz and 1 Turquoise for a Vintage Yagen at Mayoido Antiques.
Bring the Yagen back to the pharmacy, then give the resulting True Aohige Aojiru to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Barter chain
steps: Take Elizabeth's bandage to the man in Port Island Station Outskirts.
Trade the resulting student handbook at Port Island Station, then take the catnip to the cat-loving boy on Iwatodai 1F.
Return the Cat Ear Headband to Elizabeth before August 31.

entries.title: Old Document 6
steps: Open the document chest on Tartarus floor 144, then report to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Defeat 800 Shadows
steps: Reach 800 total Shadow defeats. Progress is cumulative; report each unlocked milestone to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Persona level 46+
steps: Keep any Persona at level 46 or higher in your active stock when speaking to Elizabeth. Leveling an existing Persona works; its base fusion level need not meet the target.

entries.title: Titania with Matarukaja
steps: Level Shiki-Ouji to 47 for Matarukaja, then fuse it with Kurama Tengu into Titania and inherit the skill.

entries.title: Rangda level 54+
steps: Fuse Titania and Thoth into Rangda, then level her to at least 54. Keep Rangda in your active stock when reporting.

entries.title: Sumptuous Coin
steps: Defeat a rare golden Shadow in Tziah and bring its Sumptuous Coin to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Ote-gine
steps: Open the chest requiring 3 Twilight Fragments on Tartarus floor 143. Keep the weapon until Elizabeth has seen it.

entries.title: Anatomical doll
steps: Visit the science laboratory on school 1F with the request accepted. Take the anatomical model to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Peacock Mahjong Tile
steps: With Courage rank 6, visit Red Hawk Mahjong in Port Island Station Outskirts and ask about the request. Take the tile to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Fruit Knife
steps: Accept request 68, then speak to Shinjiro at the dorm in the evening. Take the item to Elizabeth before the deadline.

entries.title: Machine Oil
steps: Accept request 69, then speak to Aigis at the dorm in the evening. Take the item to Elizabeth before the deadline.

entries.title: Old Document 7
steps: Open the document chest on Tartarus floor 172, then report to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Siegfried with Endure
steps: Level Hecatoncheires to 48 for Endure, then fuse it with Shiki-Ouji into Siegfried and inherit Endure. The Endure card from request 73 is another option.

entries.title: Daisoujou with Regenerate 3
steps: Level Suzaku to 56 for Regenerate 3, then fuse it with Hecatoncheires into Daisoujou and inherit the skill.

entries.title: Mikazuki Munechika
steps: Craft at Mayoido Antiques using Quality Nihil Blade ×1, Emerald ×3, Silver Quartz ×2.
Keep the weapon until Elizabeth has seen it.

entries.title: Inari Sushi
steps: With Academics rank 4, examine the small Inari shrine at Naganaki Shrine after accepting the request. Bring the sushi to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Sengoku-era helmet
steps: Visit the Faculty Office at school on eight separate school days after accepting the request. Continue the teacher's conversations until he gives you the helmet, then report.

entries.title: Glasses Wipe
steps: Accept request 76, then speak to Ikutsuki at the dorm in the evening. Take the item to Elizabeth before the deadline.

entries.title: Elizabeth visit: Paulownia Mall
steps: Complete other requests and the preceding outing until this invitation appears. The listed target is about 15 completed requests; some guides count eligible requests differently.
Accept the request, then speak to Elizabeth outside the Velvet Room during the daytime and choose the outing.

entries.title: Elizabeth visit: Iwatodai Station
steps: Complete other requests and the preceding outing until this invitation appears. The listed target is about 30 completed requests; some guides count eligible requests differently.
Accept the request, then speak to Elizabeth outside the Velvet Room during the daytime and choose the outing.

entries.title: Elizabeth visit: Naganaki Shrine
steps: Complete other requests and the preceding outing until this invitation appears. The listed target is about 45 completed requests; some guides count eligible requests differently.
Accept the request, then speak to Elizabeth outside the Velvet Room during the daytime and choose the outing.

entries.title: Elizabeth visit: Gekkoukan High
steps: Complete other requests and the preceding outing until this invitation appears. The listed target is about 60 completed requests; some guides count eligible requests differently.
Accept the request, then speak to Elizabeth outside the Velvet Room during the daytime and choose the outing.

entries.title: Elizabeth visit: your room
steps: Complete other requests and the preceding outing until this invitation appears. The listed target is about 80 completed requests; some guides count eligible requests differently.
Accept the request, then speak to Elizabeth outside the Velvet Room during the daytime and choose the outing.

entries.title: Old Document 8
steps: Open the document chest on Tartarus floor 198, then report to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Progress Report
steps: Open the document chest on Tartarus floor 226, then report to Elizabeth.
requirements: Harabah upper floors open December 10; the earlier request listing does not grant Tartarus access.

entries.title: Persona with Tempest Slash
steps: Chernobog starts with Tempest Slash. Fuse Mishaguji and Ganesha, retain the skill and report.

entries.title: Persona with Auto Maraku
steps: Fuse Koumokuten and Kurama Tengu into Raphael. Level Raphael to 61 for Auto Maraku and retain it when reporting.

entries.title: Alice
steps: Use special fusion with Pixie, Lilim, Narcissus and Titania. Keep Alice in your active stock when reporting.

entries.title: Loki level 75+
steps: Max the Fool Social Link through story progress to unlock Loki. Fuse Suzaku and Pazuzu, then raise Loki to at least level 75.

entries.title: Greedy Shadow Gold Medal
steps: Chase and defeat a Greedy Shadow in Harabah. Keep the Gold Medal for Elizabeth. These encounters are random, so revisit eligible floors if none appears.

entries.title: Rai Kunimitsu
steps: Open the chest requiring 3 Twilight Fragments on Tartarus floor 184. Keep the weapon until Elizabeth has seen it.

entries.title: Dojigiri Yasutsuna
steps: Open the chest requiring 3 Twilight Fragments on Tartarus floor 212. Keep the weapon until Elizabeth has seen it.

entries.title: Tonbo-kiri
steps: Craft at Mayoido Antiques using Prime Nihil Blade ×1, Diamond ×5, Gold Quartz ×2.
Keep the weapon until Elizabeth has seen it.

entries.title: Clean the station restroom
steps: Take Elizabeth's cleaning supplies to the Port Island Station restroom. Choose to scrub harder twice, then report.

entries.title: Water the school flowers
steps: Take Elizabeth's watering can to the school roof. Water the planter second from the right and return to her.

entries.title: Gourmet Dog Food
steps: Accept request 94, then speak to Koromaru at the dorm in the evening. Take the item to Elizabeth before the deadline.

entries.title: Featherman R Figure
steps: Accept request 95, then speak to Ken at the dorm in the evening. Take the item to Elizabeth before the deadline.

entries.title: Oden Juice
steps: Talk to the drink-loving student near the school persimmon tree.
During the November Kyoto trip, buy all 3 distinct regional drinks from the hotel vending machine and keep them.
After the trip, trade with the student and pay ¥5,000 for Oden Juice, then deliver it to Elizabeth.

entries.title: Christmas present
steps: Accept the request and speak to the Eccentric Man on Iwatodai Strip Mall 2F at night. He asks for proof of a good deed.
Bring the thank-you letter associated with rescuing missing people. Sources disagree whether Ayako specifically is required, so rescue everyone and collect police-station rewards as they appear.
Give the resulting present to Elizabeth by December 25.

entries.title: Masakado with Charge
steps: Complete the fusion requests that unlock Masakado. Level Setanta to 31 for Charge, then fuse it with Jack-o'-Lantern into Jikokuten and inherit Charge.
Special-fuse Zouchouten, Jikokuten, Koumokuten and Bishamonten into Masakado, passing Charge into the result.

entries.title: Shadow of the Void
steps: Clear the earlier fixed Monad Passages, then defeat Shadow of the Void in the passage on floor 255. Bring healing, status cures and charged Theurgies; see the boss reference for its skills.

entries.title: Bloody Button
steps: Wait on a normal Tartarus floor until the Reaper appears, defeat it, and keep its Bloody Button. Prepare for strong multi-element attacks, ailments and instant kills; see Combat for the full skill list.

entries.title: Ultimate adversary
steps: Finish requests 81, 99 and 100, accept request 101, and enter the final Monad challenge from floor 255 alone. Fuuka remains your navigator.
Read the optional boss preparation in Campaign before attempting this fight. Ordinary boss tactics can break its special rules.
